name: Hsu's Cybernetic Heart
description: (Tag:implant)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:stamina+)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:tech)(Tech) A high-tech cybernetic heart replacement granting superhuman physical abilities plus increased stamina and energy regeneration, weaker when your energy is lower. It can fire a chest death laser if left uncovered (implanted beneath muscle by default), charging extra reserves over time for the laser. Manifests as a ticket that perfectly implants itself in whoever rips it.
